page_title: HEI 1-2 RBL | Heidenheim v RB Leipzig 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' That's the end of the match.
90+8' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
90+7' Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tobias Welz blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to RB Leipzig.
90+4' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
90+4' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
90+3' Dani Olmo will be replaced by Lukas Klostermann (RB Leipzig).
90+2' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

85' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Mohamed Simakan plays a lovely pass into the box and finds Lois Openda (RB Leipzig). He tries his luck from close range and coolly strikes the ball into the back of the net. 1:2.
84' Substitution. Stefan Schimmer (Heidenheim) has come on for Kevin Sessa.
84' Willi Orban (RB Leipzig) climbs high to connect with a cross near the penalty spot but plants a header well wide of the right post.
83' Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.

83' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner, but his effort goes narrowly wide of the right post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
82' David Raum (RB Leipzig) is about to take a corner kick.
81' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
79' Here comes a substitution. Eljif Elmas (RB Leipzig) is brought on as a substitute for Xavi Simons.
79' Alexander Zickler has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Christoph Baumgartner (RB Leipzig) replacing Benjamin Sesko.
79' Substitution. Nicolas Seiwald (RB Leipzig) in, Amadou Haidara out.
78' David Raum (RB Leipzig) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.

78' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the top right corner. The effort, however, is blocked by Peter Gulacsi, who pulls off a stunning save!
77' The resulting corner from David Raum (RB Leipzig) is cleared.
76' Castello Lukeba (RB Leipzig) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. The linesman makes the right call and RB Leipzig will have a corner.
74' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
73' David Raum (RB Leipzig) takes the corner.
72' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) homes in on a magnificent reverse pass from Xavi Simons and strikes a crisp shot goalwards that just misses the left post.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mohamed Simakan (RB Leipzig) comes onto the pitch so that Benjamin Henrichs can be given a rest.
69' 1 - 1 GOAL 1:1! The resulting free kick is headed powerfully goalwards by Jan Schoppner and Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) glances a header from close range into the back of the net.
68' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Benedikt Gimber will be replaced by Norman Theuerkauf (Heidenheim).
68' Here is a change. Eren Dinkci is going off and Frank Schmidt gives the last tactical orders to Denis Thomalla (Heidenheim).
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nikola Dovedan (Heidenheim) replaces Marvin Pieringer.

67' The opposition can't get near Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig), who finally takes a shot inside the box. The effort looks goalbound but veers just wide of the right post at the last second. The ball goes out of play and Heidenheim will have a goal kick.
65' Kevin Muller displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
64' Heidenheim are seeing far more of the ball now.
64' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends the ball into the penalty area from a throw-in as if it's a corner kick.
63' David Raum (RB Leipzig) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
62' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
61' Benedikt Gimber (Heidenheim) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
60' A snap shot from distance by Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
59' The game is interrupted now, Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
58' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the bottom left corner. Kevin Muller is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
54' Problems for Frank Schmidt as Lennard Maloney is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Jan Schoppner (Heidenheim) replaces him.
52' The game is interrupted. Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) suffers a horrific injury!
48' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' The resulting corner from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
45+2' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

45+1' David Raum (RB Leipzig) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Welz no option but to blow his whistle. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Heidenheim.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' Kevin Sessa (Heidenheim) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for RB Leipzig.
42' 0 - 1 Goal! Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.
42' David Raum (RB Leipzig) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
39' The foul by Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) was seen by Tobias Welz who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
36' RB Leipzig seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
35' A rebound falls to Benjamin Sesko (RB Leipzig) in space inside the box. He looks up and fires in a powerful shot at goal that flies just wide of the right post.
34' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) unleashed a promising strike from a long-distance free kick, but his effort goes high over the bar so it's going to be a goal kick.
33' Benjamin Henrichs (RB Leipzig) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
30' Jan-Niklas Beste (Heidenheim) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
29' A brilliant cross into the box finds Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim), who directs his header towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
26' Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) sends a chip pass into the box, but Kevin Muller is quickest to intercept the ball.

26' RB Leipzig win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot. An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim). Tobias Welz saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul.
22' Lennard Maloney (Heidenheim) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
18' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
17' Tobias Welz blows his whistle after Amadou Haidara (RB Leipzig) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
16' RB Leipzig control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' The possession of the ball – 36:64.
9' Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
7' Tim Kleindienst (Heidenheim) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the left post.
6' Dani Olmo (RB Leipzig) plays a lovely through ball to Benjamin Sesko, but he can't beat Kevin Muller and loses the ball.

5' A great solo effort from Xavi Simons (RB Leipzig) and he attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a long-range shot low towards the middle of the goal. Kevin Muller has a clear view of it and makes a comfortable save.
4' The Heidenheim players are exchanging fine passes and are waiting for an opportunity to start an attack, but here's a mistake and a loss of possession.
3' The ball is cleared after Lois Openda (RB Leipzig) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and RB Leipzig will have the kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Tobias Welz.
